entries.title: Proverbs 28:1
segments: ¶The wicked flee when no man pursueth; but the righteous are bold as a lion.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:2
segments: ¶By the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof; but by a man of understanding [and] of knowledge, [its] stability is prolonged.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:3
segments: ¶A poor man who oppresseth the helpless is a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:4
segments: ¶They that forsake the law praise the wicked; but such as keep the law contend with them.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:5
segments: ¶Evil men understand not judgment; but they that seek Jehovah understand everything.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:6
segments: ¶Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse, double in ways, though he be rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:7
segments: ¶Whoso observeth the law is a son that hath understanding; but he that is a companion of profligates bringeth shame to his father.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:8
segments: ¶He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance gathereth it for him that is gracious to the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:9
segments: ¶He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:10
segments: ¶Whoso causeth the upright to go astray in an evil way, shall himself fall into his own pit; but the perfect shall inherit good.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:11
segments: ¶A rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:12
segments: ¶When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men conceal themselves.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:13
segments: ¶He that covereth his transgressions shall not prosper; but whoso confesseth and forsaketh [them] shall obtain mercy.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:14
segments: ¶Happy is the man that feareth always; but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:15
segments: ¶A roaring lion, and a ranging bear, is a wicked ruler over a poor people.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:16
segments: ¶The prince void of intelligence is also a great oppressor: he that hateth covetousness shall prolong [his] days.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:17
segments: ¶A man laden with the blood of [any] person, fleeth to the pit: let no man stay him.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:18
segments: ¶Whoso walketh in integrity shall be saved; but he that is perverted in [his] double ways, shall fall in one [of them].

entries.title: Proverbs 28:19
segments: ¶He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread; but he that followeth the worthless shall have poverty enough.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:20
segments: ¶A faithful man aboundeth with blessings; but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:21
segments: ¶To have respect of persons is not good; but for a piece of bread will a man transgress.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:22
segments: ¶He that hath an evil eye hasteth after wealth, and knoweth not that poverty shall come upon him.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:23
segments: ¶He that rebuketh a man shall afterwards find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:24
segments: ¶Whoso robbeth his father and his mother, and saith, It is no transgression, the same is the companion of a destroyer.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:25
segments: ¶He that is puffed up in soul exciteth contention; but he that relieth upon Jehovah shall be made fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:26
segments: ¶He that confideth in his own heart is a fool; but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:27
segments: ¶He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack; but he that withdraweth his eyes shall have many a curse.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:28
segments: ¶When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous increase.
